title: Inbox stored sources
description: Whether a manager retains items from each built-in Inbox source, covering every open item and all completed items kept in history, not only the bounded GET /api/v1/inbox list. The field is absent or null when any manager is too old or cannot answer, which means unknown and preserves the clients' previous behavior (docs/protocol/protocol.md, #17399).

InboxStoredSources.description: Core-computed source presence. Lark covers both lark and larkcli items. These are facts about retained data, independent of whether the corresponding module or extension is offered.

lark.description: At least one retained open or completed item has source lark or larkcli.

mail.description: At least one retained open or completed item has source mail.
